tools.name: fetch_tdocs
tools.description:
Fetch TDoc details by official TDoc number. Use this when a TDoc number is known and the user needs all available TDoc-related information fields, including metadata, CR fields, revision fields, and tdoc's full text.

Return fields are fixed:
- tdoc_id: internal TDoc identifier
- tdoc_number: official TDoc number
- tdoc_type: TDoc type
- tdoc_meeting: meeting reference
- tdoc_title: TDoc title
- tdoc_related_wis: related work items
- tdoc_wis_groups: grouped related work item details
- tdoc_work_groups: 3GPP work groups
- tdoc_status: TDoc status
- tdoc_uploaded: upload date
- tdoc_source: source or contributor
- tdoc_std_source: normalized source or contributor
- tdoc_for: TDoc purpose or for field
- cr_category: CR category
- tdoc_spec: related specification
- tdoc_release: 3GPP release
- cr_summary: CR summary
- cr_reason: CR reason
- cr_consequences: CR consequences
- tdoc_is_revision_of: previous TDoc revised by this TDoc
- tdoc_revised_to: later TDoc revision
- tdoc_abstract: TDoc abstract
- tdoc_secretary_remarks: secretary remarks
- tdoc_revise_related: revision relationship details
- fulltext: tdoc's full text

tdoc_number.description: Official TDoc number(s), not TDOC_ID. Use this MCP tool whenever the user provides a TDoc number and asks to look it up, summarize it, inspect its abstract/CR fields, or fetch its full text/content. The returned fields are fixed and include metadata, CR fields, and fulltext when available; tdoc_abstract can be null, and fulltext can be null if no remote full text is available. Accepts a string, comma-separated string, or list. Examples: 'S2-2000289', 'RP-240423', 'S2-2000289,S2-2001038', ['S2-2000289','S2-2001038']. Do not pass internal ids like 'p2541314354989645788-9038543113892468309'.
tdoc_number.title: Tdoc Number

tools.name: search_tdocs
tools.description:
Search TDocs by either semantic meaning or exact metadata filters. Use mode='semantic' to search TDocs with a natural-language query. Use mode='metadata' to search TDocs by metadata filters such as number, title, source, meeting, upload date, work group, type, status, release, spec, CR fields, or fulltext keywords. Each result returns the main TDoc fields that are most useful for identifying and comparing matching TDocs.

Return fields are fixed:
- tdoc_id: internal TDoc identifier
- tdoc_number: official TDoc number
- tdoc_title: TDoc title
- tdoc_abstract: TDoc abstract
- tdoc_source: source or contributor
- tdoc_meeting: meeting reference
- tdoc_uploaded: upload date
- tdoc_work_groups: 3GPP work groups
- tdoc_type: TDoc type
- tdoc_status: TDoc status
- tdoc_release: 3GPP release

mode.description: Search mode. Allowed values: 'semantic' or 'metadata'. Examples: 'semantic' for natural-language recall; 'metadata' for exact metadata queries. Do not pass values like 'hybrid', 'keyword', or booleans.
mode.title: Mode

query.description: Search text. Required in semantic mode; optional in metadata mode when filters are provided. Examples: 'handover', 'handover procedure correction', 'network slicing', 'Measurement configuration'. Do not pass raw JSON here; use filters for structured filters.
query.title: Query

rows.description: Maximum number of TDocs to return. Integer examples: 1, 5, 20, 100. Clamped to 1..1000; metadata mode returns at most 100 per call.
rows.title: Rows

start.description: Zero-based offset for metadata mode pagination; ignored in semantic mode. Integer examples: 0 for first page, 20 for second page when rows=20, 100 for later pages.
start.title: Start

filters.description:
Optional filter object; pass an object/dict, not a string. Date values accept YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

filters
field | example | mode
--- | --- | ---
number | R1-231234 | metadata
title | handover | metadata
abstract | network slicing | metadata
fulltext | measurement configuration | metadata

cr_consequences | cannot be cancelled | metadata

meeting_location | Online | metadata

meeting_date_end | 2021-12-31 | metadata,semantic

upload_date_from | 2021-01-01 | metadata,semantic
upload_date_to | 2021-12-31 | metadata,semantic
work_groups | 3GPP RAN2 | metadata,semantic

Examples: {'number':'S2-2000289'}, {'type':'CR','status':'agreed'}, {'upload_date_from':'2021-01-01','upload_date_to':'2021-12-31'}.
Supported semantic work_groups values: 3GPP RAN1, 3GPP RAN2.
filters.title: Filters

tools.name: novelty_lite_get
tools.description: [GET /v2/novelty/lite_run/get] 查询查新 Lite 任务进展和结果。task_id 必填，取自 novelty_lite_submit 返回的 data.task_id。任务运行中默认只返回状态和步骤进展，不返回步骤结果；如需返回已完成步骤结果，传 include_step_results=true。任务完成后默认返回全部步骤结果。step_ids 可指定返回特定步骤的状态和结果；未完成则只返回状态，已完成则返回与 include_step_results=true 相同的步骤结果。可选 step_ids：novelty_summary、novelty_feature_extract、novelty_keywords_extract、novelty_lite_search、novelty_lite_candidate_patents、novelty_feature_comparison、novelty_lite_report_generate。
